sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Permits and graduated licensing

FACT_ID: sec03-R01 | anchor: A03
At Level Two the passenger limit is no non-family passenger under twenty during the first six months and no more than one during the second six months [A03].
Why it matters: group passenger-limits; difficulty high; prereq sec03-F23; confusables sec03-F12, sec03-F23 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R02 | anchor: A03
The conviction-free window is six months at Level One but twelve months at Level Two, and in both cases a new conviction restarts the clock [A03].
Why it matters: group conviction-windows; difficulty high; prereq sec03-F27; confusables sec03-F27, sec03-F29 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R03 | anchor: A03
Two convictions at Level One bring a ninety-day revocation followed by retesting, whereas a second moving-violation conviction at Level Two revokes driving until eighteen with retesting as a first-time applicant [A03].
Why it matters: group conviction-penalties; difficulty high; prereq sec03-F28; confusables sec03-F28, sec03-F30 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec03-R04 | anchor: A01
A regular instruction permit stays valid for six months, but a holder never licensed at Level Two must keep it at least thirty days before taking the road skills test [A01].
Why it matters: group regular-permit; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F07; confusables sec03-F07, sec03-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec03-R05 | anchor: A02
Level One holders may drive only between five in the morning and ten at night, while Level Two holders may drive at any hour but need a supervising adult between ten at night and five in the morning [A02].
Why it matters: group driving-hours; difficulty high; prereq sec03-F11; confusables sec03-F11, sec03-F21 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec03-R06 | anchor: A02
A Level One permit expires on the eighteenth birthday with a thirty-day grace period for the road skills exam, and surrendering it means repeating the examination and another one hundred eighty conviction-free days [A02].
Why it matters: group level-one-expiry; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F17; confusables sec03-F17, sec03-F18 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec03-R07 | anchor: A04
Level Three requires age seventeen and twelve conviction-free months at Level Two, yet a qualified driver may choose to stay at Level Two with its restrictions until eighteen [A04].
Why it matters: group level-three; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F33; confusables sec03-F32, sec03-F33 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec03-R08 | anchor: A04
The Drive for Five cycle gives a five-year license, but the first license in the cycle may run anywhere from three to seven years so that expiry lands in a year when the age is divisible by five [A04].
Why it matters: group expiration; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F38; confusables sec03-F38, sec03-F39 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec03-R09 | anchor: A05
The renewal fee is five dollars for each year until the age divisible by five, so the total varies with the term even though the per-year rate has not increased [A05].
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F41; confusables sec03-F41, sec03-F48 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec03-R10 | anchor: A05
A license that expires on the eighteenth or twenty-first birthday carries a thirty-day grace period meant for obtaining the correctly colored license, a different purpose from the Level One grace period for the road skills exam [A05].
Why it matters: group grace-periods; difficulty high; prereq sec03-F40; confusables sec03-F18, sec03-F40 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec03-R11 | anchor: A06
A Level Three license costs two dollars and fifty cents per year when issued at seventeen but five dollars per year when first issued at eighteen [A06].
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F47; confusables sec03-F47, sec03-F48 [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec03-R12 | anchor: A05
Failing to produce a license on demand is a misdemeanor, but a driver whose license was valid at arrest and who later produces it in court or at the officer's office is not convicted [A05].
Why it matters: group carry-license; difficulty medium; prereq sec03-F46; confusables sec03-F46 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec03-R13 | anchor: A01
Driver examiners give the official vision and knowledge tests, while the online Know to Drive test is only part of the application and its certificate is not permission to drive [A01].
Why it matters: group testing; difficulty low; prereq sec03-F02; confusables sec03-F02, sec03-F05 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so its permit and graduated-licensing chapter changes at most with a new edition.
